known_results: Both historical split prediction tables, AUROC/AP, and cross-cohort genomic similarity are already inspected.
purpose: Verify feature/label identity, train-only nested selection and exact historical predictions from released compact features.
outer_splits: StratifiedKFold 5 shuffle seed20260823; original deterministic size-balanced complete-CC fivefold
inner_selection: Original GroupKFold min(4,n_training_groups); candidate C=(.01,.1,1,10), mean validation AP across folds with two classes in both partitions; first maximum wins. Fallback C=1 if fewer than3 groups.
model: Training-only median imputer and StandardScaler; balanced elastic-net LogisticRegression l1_ratio=.5 solver=saga max_iter=5000 random_state=42
prohibitions: No new candidates, outcome-driven sample exclusions, performance optimization or replacing historical artifacts. Any mismatch is an audit finding.
